doc.description:
Play tunes on a passive piezo buzzer
Plays a tune at startup, and any tune on request from the GCS settings. The buzzer is driven with a PWM output, the board defines BUZZER_GPIO, BUZZER_PIN, BUZZER_AF, BUZZER_PWMD and BUZZER_PWM_CHANNEL. On the Cube Orange this is the ALARM pin (TIM2_CH1), on the BUZZER pin (5) of the carrier board USB port. Implementation for ChibiOS. To add a melody from an audio file (mp3, wav, ...), sw/tools/buzzer/mp3_to_buzzer.py writes the buzzer_note C array to add to buzzer_tunes.c (needs ffmpeg and numpy, see its --help).

define.name: BUZZER_TUNES_STARTUP_TUNE
define.description: Tune at startup (BUZZER_TUNES_x), BUZZER_TUNES_NONE for silence

define.name: BUZZER_TUNES_EVENTS_ON
define.description: Armed and alert tunes enabled at startup (also a GCS setting), off by default

define.name: BUZZER_TUNES_ARMED_TUNE
define.description: Optional tune played in a loop while the motors are armed, stopped when disarmed

define.name: BUZZER_TUNES_ALERT
define.description: Optional C condition: while true, BUZZER_TUNES_ALERT_TUNE plays in a loop (Stop from the GCS mutes it until the next alert)

define.name: BUZZER_TUNES_ALERT_HEADER
define.description: Header to include for the alert condition

define.name: BUZZER_TUNES_ALERT_TUNE
define.description: Tune played in a loop while the alert condition is true

define.name: BUZZER_TUNES_ALERT_END_TUNE
define.description: Tune played once when the alert condition becomes false (stopped if the motors are disarmed)

define.name: BUZZER_TUNES_RTTTL_1
define.description: Custom tunes 1 to 3 (BUZZER_TUNES_RTTTL_1..3) in RTTTL format, set them in an airframe section with type string
